findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "legal_verify_citations" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Check the South African case citations and Acts in a piece of text against GetLawED's library of official copies and verified records. Each item comes back as found, mismatch (the citation belongs to a different case), name_only, not_found, repealed or unchecked. "not_found"/"unchecked" means "check" → after: "Check the South African case citations and Acts in a piece of text against GetLawED's library of official copies and verified records.
